answer.new_information: NVIDIA said on 2026-07-02 that 12 games, including Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains, would join GeForce NOW in July 2026. The article also describes Summer Sale discounts on 12-month Performance and Ultimate memberships. These concern consumer cloud-gaming offerings and promotions, not NVIDIA’s financial commitments or guarantees to cloud providers, and do not concern a guarantee for OpenAI’s Ohio data-center lease.
